system.name: Deep Video Discovery (DVD)
system.one_liner: An LLM agent that treats a long video as a search environment: it reasons, calls search tools over a multi-granular clip database and iterates on observations to answer.

content.variant_note: a sequence-diagram with three coloured lifelines (reasoning LLM, search toolset, video database) carrying one real question through thought, tool-use and observation turns, beside a radar chart of the headline result
content.argues: An agent that autonomously reasons, picks search tools and iterates over video clips answers long-video questions, and beats all compared methods on every LVBench category.
content.subject: One real question about a video answered through Thought, Tool use and Observation turns, and a radar chart comparing the agent with four baselines on seven LVBench categories.

new_tags.name: lifeline-sequence-diagram
new_tags.what: a sequence diagram with one vertical lifeline per actor (LLM, tool, store) under icon header boxes and horizontal message arrows carrying typed text

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw an agent run as a sequence diagram: one lifeline per actor in its own colour, typed text turns (Thought, Tool use, Observation) coloured by actor, a real question and answer at the two ends; pair it with a radar chart as the headline result.
lessons.suits: Tool-using agent papers whose contribution is the tool set and the adaptive reasoning loop, with one multi-category benchmark summarising the gain.

evidence: which autonomously reasons on user query, iterative use tools to obtain the final answer.
we conceptualize the challenge of understanding extremely long videos as a multi-step information search problem

summary: Deep Video Discovery (DVD) is an LLM agent that treats a long video as an environment to search: it reasons, calls search tools over a multi-granular video database and iterates on its observations. Figure 1 has two halves. On the left, a sequence-style trace with three lifelines under icon header boxes (LLM with Reasoning in green, Search Toolset in orange, Video Database in blue) carries one real question, Who gets the lollipop last?, with a video thumbnail, through Thought, Tool use (ClipSearch, GlobalBrowse), gathering info and Observation turns to the final answer. On the right, a radar chart compares Ours with MR. Video, OpenAI o3, Gemini-2.0-flash and GPT-4o on seven LVBench categories, Ours outermost in red.
summary_zh: DVD 把长视频当作可搜索的环境，让 LLM 智能体推理并调用检索工具。图1左：时序图式轨迹，绿色 LLM、橙色搜索工具、蓝色视频数据库三条生命线，附真实问答；右：雷达图比较 Ours 与四个基线在 LVBench 七类任务的得分。
notes: The index counts one panel while the pre-screen counted two; here the two halves are counted because the caption names them Left and Right, although neither is framed or titled in the figure. contribution-mosaic is added for the radar half. The radar chart, with its polygons and labels, is a bitmap (about 91 x 106 pt for the polygons).
